text_block_list.text: I can't believe I lost again. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I need you to give it to me<n>straight. How
was my performance<n>today?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back—just let me have it.<n>Feelings will
only muddle my<n>calculations.

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! Let's have a<n>meeting as soon
as we get back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's a meticulous and time-consuming<n>process, but
strategizing for the sake<n>of victory is worth it!

Afterwards, Biwa Hayahide and I<n>hunker down to
discuss the race and<n>what can be done to improve
her<n>performance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What else should I focus on if not<n>that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's clearly something wrong<n>with the way I'm
running my races<n>now! Why else would I have
failed<n>this badly?!
choice_data_list: That's not the right way to look at it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: You have to look at both the good and the bad.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'm the one who's letting my<n>feelings get in
the way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I need to go clear my head.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you for being so blunt. I<n>needed to hear that.

Biwa Hayahide goes off on a short<n>run to blow off
some steam. Later,<n>she joins me for a strategy
meeting<n>feeling much better.
